appStore.name: Fridge Pulse
appStore.subtitle: Use food before it expires
appStore.promotionalText: Your kitchen’s vital sign. Snap a photo of your fridge, see what needs eating first, and get meal ideas that use it up. Try free for 2 weeks.
appStore.description:
Stop throwing away food you forgot about.

Fridge Pulse turns a quick photo of your fridge, freezer or pantry into a simple list of what you have and when it needs eating. It reminds you before things go off and suggests meals that use up the most urgent ingredients first.

HOW IT WORKS
- Snap a photo of a shelf. Fridge Pulse spots the food and reads printed dates when it can.
- Something unfamiliar? Fridge Pulse searches the web for the exact product and shows you a picture to confirm, then remembers it next time.
- Back from the shops? Photograph the receipt and everything on it is added, each item headed for the fridge, freezer or pantry.
- Or scan each product's barcode as you unpack, and Fridge Pulse knows exactly what it is.
- Check the list, fix anything that looks off, and save. You are always in control.
- Your Pulse home screen shows what needs using first, colour-coded by how soon it expires.
- Get a gentle reminder the day before food expires.
- Get meal ideas built around what is about to go, with your diet and servings in mind.
- See calories, protein, carbs and fat for your food and for every meal idea.
- Set a protein goal from your weight. Meals you cook log themselves, and the Meals tab can put the most protein first.
- Connect Apple Health or Health Connect for your steps and active days.
- See what your thrown-out food cost, straight from your receipts.
- Share one fridge and shopping list with your household. One household plan covers everyone.
- A weekly score for food rescued, protein goals met and active days.

MADE FOR REAL KITCHENS
- Works for the fridge, freezer and pantry.
- Add items by hand any time.
- See how much food you rescue instead of binning.
- Your food list stays on your phone unless you share it with your household. No account needed.
- No ads.

FREE FOR 2 WEEKS, THEN $9.99 PER MONTH OR $59.99 PER YEAR
Try everything free for 2 weeks. After that, Fridge Pulse is $9.99 per month or $59.99 per year. The household plan is $14.99 per month or $89.99 per year and covers up to 8 people in your shared household. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at the end of the free trial. A monthly plan renews automatically every month, and a yearly plan every year, unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID account settings.

A NOTE ON FOOD SAFETY
Dates are estimates and photo scanning can make mistakes. Always check the packaging and use your own judgement. When in doubt, throw it out.

PRIVACY
Photos and ingredient lists are sent to an AI service (Anthropic's Claude) only if you agree, and Fridge Pulse does not keep your photos.
